title: オオカミの群れと暮らしていた「シエラモレナの狼少年」、80歳で死去スペイン
titleTranslation: The 'Wolf Boy of Sierra Morena,' who lived with a wolf pack, dies at 80 in Spain (CNN.co.jp) - Yahoo! News
summary: A Spanish man known as the 'Wolf Boy of Sierra Morena,' who was abandoned as a child and spent 12 years living in the wild with a pack of wolves before eventually returning to human society, has died at age 80.

sentences.text: （CNN） 少年時代をオオカミの群れで過ごし、人間社会に戻ってからは「シエラモレナの狼少年」と呼ばれるようになったスペインの男性が死去した。
sentences.translation: (CNN) A Spanish man who spent his boyhood living with a pack of wolves, and who came to be known as the 'Wolf Boy of Sierra Morena' after returning to human society, has died.

sentences.text: 80歳だった。
sentences.translation: He was 80 years old.

sentences.text: マルコス・ロドリゲス・パントーハさんは少年時代の大半、人との接触を断ったまま、スペインの人里離れた山中で過ごした。

tokens.gloss: as is, while remaining (in a state)
to be far from, separate from

sentences.translation: Marcos Rodríguez Pantoja spent most of his boyhood in the remote mountains of Spain, cut off from contact with people.

sentences.text: 幼い頃に不幸が重なって見捨てられ、オオカミに育てられる特異な12年間を送った。
sentences.translation: As a young child, a series of misfortunes led to him being abandoned, and he spent an extraordinary 12 years being raised by wolves.

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんはその後、文明社会へ復帰。
sentences.translation: Rodríguez later returned to civilized society.

sentences.text: 地元自治体の発表によると、2001年にランテという集落に住み着き、先週80歳で亡くなるまで暮らしていた。
sentences.translation: According to the local municipality, he settled in a hamlet called Rante in 2001 and lived there until his death last week at age 80.

sentences.text: 最晩年のロドリゲスさんを知る男性は、スペインの公共放送局RTVEに「大地や風、空気、雨、獣の巣穴から生まれたような人だった」と証言する。
sentences.translation: A man who knew Rodríguez in his final years told Spanish public broadcaster RTVE, 'He was like a person born from the earth, the wind, the air, the rain, and animal dens.'

sentences.text: 「人間と一緒だと居心地が良くないので、オオカミと過ごした日々が一番幸せだった、といつも言っていた」
sentences.translation: 'He always said he wasn't comfortable around people, and that the days he spent with the wolves were the happiest of his life.'

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんは1946年、内戦と世界大戦からの復興途上にあったスペインで生まれた。

tokens.gloss: in the process of, on the way

sentences.translation: Rodríguez was born in 1946 in Spain, which was still on the road to recovery from civil war and world war.

sentences.text: 生地は南部の村アニョーラで、そこから貧困にさいなまれる人生が始まった。
sentences.translation: He was born in the southern village of Añora, where a life plagued by poverty began.

sentences.text: ガブリエル・マニラ教授によれば、母親の死後、きょうだいは親戚の家に引き取られたものの、ロドリゲスさんは父親と一緒に残った。

tokens.gloss: conditional particle (~によれば: according to)
to take in, take custody of

sentences.translation: According to Professor Gabriel Manila, after their mother's death his siblings were taken in by relatives, but Rodríguez stayed with his father.

sentences.text: 父親は再婚し、家族を連れてシエラモレナ山脈へ移住すると、木炭作りを始めた。
sentences.translation: His father remarried, moved the family to the Sierra Morena mountains, and began making charcoal.

sentences.text: RTVEの報道によると、ロドリゲスさんは継母から虐待を受け、わずか7歳の時、高齢のヤギ飼いの元へ売られた。
sentences.translation: According to RTVE, Rodríguez was abused by his stepmother and, at just seven years old, was sold to an elderly goatherd.

sentences.text: 「彼らに山の中の洞窟へ連れて行かれた。
sentences.translation: 'They took me to a cave in the mountains.'

sentences.text: すると、ひげを生やした小柄な老人が、コルクの靴を履いて出てきた」。

tokens.gloss: auxiliary verb (to come and do / do and come)

sentences.translation: 'Then a small, bearded old man wearing cork shoes came out.'

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんはマニラ教授のインタビューにそう振り返り、荒野での生活の手ほどきを受けた経験を語った。
sentences.translation: Rodríguez recalled this in an interview with Professor Manila, describing his introduction to life in the wild.

sentences.text: 「オオカミの遠吠えが響き、キツネや野生のヤギ、シカ、サソリ、ヘビもいた。
sentences.translation: 'Wolves' howls echoed, and there were also foxes, wild goats, deer, scorpions, and snakes.'

sentences.text: 夜になると、こうした動物の声が聞こえてきて怖かった」

tokens.gloss: auxiliary verb (to come and do / do and come)

sentences.translation: 'At night, hearing these animals' cries was frightening.'

sentences.text: ヤギ飼いはロドリゲスさんの面倒を見てくれた。

tokens.gloss: trouble, care (面倒を見る: to take care of)
auxiliary verb (to do for one's benefit)

sentences.translation: The goatherd took care of Rodríguez.

sentences.text: 動物の皮で体を温めてもらい、ヤギの乳しぼりの仕方や、棒を使ってウサギを狩る方法を教えられた。

tokens.gloss: auxiliary verb (to receive the favor of doing)

sentences.translation: He was kept warm with animal hides and taught how to milk goats and how to hunt rabbits with a stick.

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんはこの老人の指導の下、「自然界の掟」を学んだと、マニラ教授は研究の中で記している。
sentences.translation: Professor Manila writes in his research that, under this old man's guidance, Rodríguez learned the 'laws of nature.'

sentences.text: ヤギ飼いが突然姿を消すと、ロドリゲスさんは自力で生き延びるため、覚えた技能を駆使した。

tokens.gloss: to erase, make disappear (姿を消す: to vanish)
for the purpose of, in order to

sentences.translation: When the goatherd suddenly vanished, Rodríguez used the skills he had learned to survive on his own.

sentences.text: オオカミの子どもたちに餌を運び、危険を察知して遠吠えしたところ、オオカミの群れから信頼を得ることができた。

tokens.gloss: indicates a situation or point in time
nominalizer (turns a verb/clause into a noun)

sentences.translation: By bringing food to wolf cubs and howling to warn of danger, he was able to earn the trust of the wolf pack.

sentences.text: 「私が泣いていると、オオカミたちが飛びかかってきた。

tokens.gloss: auxiliary verb (to come and do / do and come)

sentences.translation: 'When I cried, the wolves would pounce on me.'

sentences.text: それから、洞窟にあるオオカミの巣穴へと案内された」。
sentences.translation: 'Then I was led to the wolves' den in the cave.'

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんはマニラ教授にそう振り返り、オオカミの子どもたちがロドリゲスさんを歓迎してじゃれ回る様子を説明した。
sentences.translation: Rodríguez recalled this to Professor Manila, describing how the wolf cubs welcomed him and played around him.

sentences.text: ロドリゲスさんは文明を避け、人の声が聞こえるたびに身を隠していたが、19歳の時、「渓谷で道に迷い一人きりで」いたところを治安警備隊に発見された。

tokens.gloss: to lose one's way, get lost
indicates a situation or point in time

sentences.translation: Rodríguez avoided civilization and hid himself whenever he heard human voices, but at 19 he was discovered by the Civil Guard while 'lost alone in a valley.'
